summary: NEXUS-OFFLINE Phase 2 (Online Mode via Gemini 3 Flash) + Zero-Trust Enterprise Mode + Audit Export verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed (online/query for search/meaning/knowledge, empty-query 400, history GET/DELETE, audit/export shape, offline/status air-gap vs online, status regression sans _id). Frontend: All 17 UI flows passed on mobile viewport (390x844) — online-mode-switch toggles amber ONLINE MODE ON badge, sim-online-search-btn opens online-query-result-modal with loading state and real Gemini answer, MEANING query pill renders and returns definition, blocked path with Online OFF logs failed command and shows no modal, Enterprise mode expands with Primary Owner + Add Member, TEST_Alice added as ADMIN then enrolled (mic btn disappears, shows '96.1% · Tier 1+2'), export-audit-btn opens audit-export-modal with RECORDS=7 / ENGINE=v1 / SIGNED AT / JSON preview, and TerminalHeader 'ONLINE MODE: ON' badge is consistent across all 5 tabs (Wake Word, Commands, Voiceprint, Privacy DB, System Setup). Green 'Voiceprint & local DB stayed offline' footer present in query modal. Legacy MaterialCommunityIcons warning ('terminal' not a valid icon name) still emitted from TerminalHeader — non-blocking but should be fixed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"terminal" is not a valid icon name for family "material-community"' emitted repeatedly on every screen. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TerminalHeader.tsx — however the current TerminalHeader.tsx uses 'web' and 'shield-check', so 'terminal' icon is being referenced elsewhere (possibly _layout tab bar). Search the tabs layout and replace with a valid MCI name such as 'console-line' or 'console'.

action_items: (Low priority) Fix the invalid MaterialCommunityIcons name 'terminal' warning — likely in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx tab bar; replace with 'console-line' or another valid MCI icon.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id in every projection ({"_id": 0}) for status, online_query_logs, and audit export.
Online query endpoint properly validates empty query (400), returns 502 on LLM failure, and uses LlmChat with gemini-3-flash-preview and Emergent LLM key from env.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded URLs. All interactive elements carry testID attributes.
seed_data_creation: Test harness auto-creates online_query_logs via /api/online/query. TEST_-prefixed status check row and TEST_Alice enterprise member created during runs (client-side state only for the member).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All Online Mode + Enterprise + Audit Export flows are production-ready. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_offline.py can be re-run as regression. The audit export modal fetch takes ~1-3 seconds, always wait_for_timeout(3000+) after clicking export-audit-btn before asserting on RECORDS/ENGINE/SIGNED AT labels. Tab labels are: 'Wake Word', 'Commands', 'Voiceprint', 'Privacy DB', 'System Setup' (NOT 'Wizard').
